changelog: Fixed the real cause of a trailer's caption naming the wrong movie: a channel's queue-level trailer insertion (Trailers: Preview) already knows exactly which movie a trailer promotes (several programmes ahead, recorded on the trailer's own entry), but ChannelSchedule stamped every queue item's NextProgram - trailers included - with whatever simply played next in the queue, discarding that choice. A trailer now carries its own recorded promotion instead.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
